cmd: tc filter add dev dummy1 parent ffff: handle 0x1 prio 65535 protocol ipv4 matchall action pass
desc: positive: Add ingress matchall filter for protocol ipv4 and action PASS with priority at 16-bit maximum

match.pattern: (?sm)^filter parent ffff: protocol ip pref 65535 matchall.*handle 0x1.*gact action pass.*ref 1 bind 1

pre: ip link add dummy1 type dummy && ip link set dummy1 up
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 ingress

readback.cmd: tc filter get dev dummy1 parent ffff: handle 1 prio 65535 protocol ipv4 matchall
readback.name: verify
